other_conditions: Family income must be less than ₹1,50,000 for general and special categories (no income limit for widowed or disabled women)
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Karnataka
Applicant must not have defaulted on any past loan with any financial institution
Preference is given to extremely poor, destitute, widows, and physically challenged women
Preference may be given to candidates who have undergone prior skill development or vocational training conducted by KSWDC or any other department
Around 10% of the target is earmarked for members of World Bank‑assisted Swashakthi or Stree Shakthi groups
benefits_summary: Provides subsidized loans up to 50% for SC/ST women and up to 30% (maximum ₹90,000) for general and special category women, along with skill‑development training.
